verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a self-hosted AI platform with computer-control features, so pairing other devices is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows the assistant pairing with phones or computers to take screenshots, use a camera, push device notifications, or control media playback. What the evidence does show is adjacent and earns no credit: installing the web UI as a PWA on a phone, supervising an agent away from the desk, sending user webhooks when a response is ready, and running voice/video calls.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant reaches beyond one machine — paired phones and computers it can use for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback
